readmeMarkdown: # Antigravity Context Mode > **Stop context bloat. Save 90%+ of your prompt tokens. Keep your agent fast, focused, and sharp.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antigravity-plugin-context-mode.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antigravity-plugin-context-mode) [![Live Simulator](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live%20Simulator-domush.github.io-10b981?style=flat&logo=github)](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-context-mode/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Zero Runtime Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)]() [![Antigravity App Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity%20App-Native%20Plugin-6366f1.svg)]() **Antigravity Context Mode** is a free, local-first plugin built specifically for the **Google Antigravity App**. It prevents terminal commands, build logs, and multi-megabyte source files from flooding your conversation history — saving thousands of tokens per turn and stopping "agent amnesia" in its tracks. > 🌐 **Interactive Live Simulator & Documentation:** [domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-context-mode](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-context-mode/) --- ## Quick Install (10 Seconds) Install directly into Google Antigravity using `npx`: ```bash # Global install (available across all Antigravity chats) npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode install # Or per-project install (scoped to current workspace only) npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode install --workspace ``` Restart or open the **Google Antigravity App**, and Context Mode is active immediately. --- ## The Problem: Context Window Bloat When an AI coding agent executes tools, standard workflows dump everything directly into your conversation context: * Running `Get-Content Logs/Editor.log` dumps **65 KB (~16,000 tokens)** into your prompt. * Running test suites, compiler outputs, or git diffs dumps **100+ KB** of repetitive text. * Reading large files or documentation dumps **thousands of lines** of irrelevant boilerplate. ### Why this hurts: 1. **Agent Amnesia**: Important system instructions, user constraints, and earlier architectural decisions get drowned out. 2. **Slower Responses**: Generation times climb as the context window fills up with raw text. 3. **Burned Quota**: You hit model context ceilings and rate limits after only a few turns. --- ## How It Works ```text ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 1. Agent attempts to read a large file or command │ │ (e.g. 5,000-line build log or 40 KB source file) │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 2. Pre-Tool Lifecycle Hook Intercepts Unbounded Dumps │ │ • Files under 8 KB pass through normally │ │ • Un-paged dumps over 8 KB are safely intercepted │ │ • Images, docs, and chat attachments are exempted │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 3. Sandboxed Execution ("Thinking in Code") │ │ • Agent filters data locally using Node/Python │ │ • Indexes text into local SQLite FTS5 BM25 database │ │ • Returns only the exact answer or error to chat! │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## Proven Results Tested live on real-world build logs and source files in the Antigravity App: | Operation | Without Context Mode | With Context Mode | Savings | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **Parsing 665-line Unity Editor.log** | 65,242 B (~16,300 tokens) | **550 B (~137 tokens)** | **99.2% saved** | | **Full File Read on 40 KB component** | 40,960 B (~10,240 tokens) | Intercepted & paged to 50 lines (**~800 tokens**) | **92.1% saved** | | **Searching Compiler Warnings** | Entire log dumped into chat | Top 2 ranked FTS5 snippets (**~350 tokens**) | **97.8% saved** | --- ## Key Features * 🛡️ **Automated Interception**: Blocks unbounded file dumps and commands before they bloat your context window. * 🧠 **Intelligent Language-Aware Chunking (v2.0)**: Intelligently chunks source code (JS, TS, Python, Java, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, C/C++, Shell, SQL), Markdown, JSON, YAML, TOML, HTML/XML, and logs. Never slices methods, headings, or stack traces mid-block. * 🎯 **Context-Expanding Search Results**: `ctx_search` returns complete source code methods, paragraphs, or markdown sections intact, along with `startLine`, `endLine`, and enclosing scope metadata. * ⚡ **Thinking in Code**: Filters multi-thousand-line outputs in 50 ms via local sandboxed scripts. * 🔍 **Local SQLite FTS5 Search**: Indexes files and logs locally on your machine with BM25 keyword matching and trigram search. * 📊 **Built-In Sidecar Dashboard**: Real-time stats pane inside Antigravity showing tokens kept out of context. * 🔒 **100% Local & Private**: All indexed data stays on your machine in `~/.context-mode/context.db`. Zero network calls. * 📦 **Zero Dependencies**: Pure native Node.js (`node:sqlite`). No native builds, no `node-gyp`. --- ## Available MCP Tools Once installed, Context Mode provides 7 specialized tools for your agent: | Tool | What It Does | | :--- | :--- | | **`ctx_execute`** | Runs sandboxed Node.js, Python, or PowerShell scripts to inspect files and extract answers without context dumps. | | **`ctx_search`** | Searches files, directories, or URLs with Just-In-Time auto-indexing using local SQLite FTS5 BM25 + Trigram RRF. | | **`ctx_batch`** | Runs multiple terminal commands in batch and indexes the combined output. | | **`ctx_stats`** | Displays a formatted context savings report and token metrics. | | **`ctx_resume`** | Returns recent indexed sources and state pointers after context compactions. | | **`ctx_doctor`** | Checks SQLite database health, WAL mode, and platform runtimes. | | **`ctx_purge`** | Clears stored sources and events from SQLite. | --- ## Managing the Plugin ### Enable / Disable Anytime Open the **Google Antigravity App** → **Customizations** → **Plugins**, and toggle **Context Mode** on or off with one click. ### Adjust Cutoffs You can adjust the file read cutoff directly in the sidecar dashboard dropdown (`2 KB`, `4 KB`, `8 KB`, `16 KB`, `32 KB`, `64 KB`, or `none`). ### Uninstall To remove the plugin from your system: ```bash # Remove global plugin npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode uninstall # Remove per-project plugin npx antigravity-plugin-context-mode uninstall --workspace ``` --- ## License MIT © [Phillip Webber](https://github.com/Domush)

## Version 2.0.0 — The Semantic Intelligence Update - Major update!
*Release Date: November 21, 2026*

### 🌟 Headline: Intelligent Semantic Chunking & Complete Code Context
Prior to v2.0, large files were cut into chunks based on fixed line and byte boundaries. While fast, this occasionally split functions in half or separated an error message from its stack trace. 

**v2.0.0 introduces an AST-aware semantic chunking engine (`lib/chunker.js`)**. Instead of cutting text arbitrarily, Context Mode understands the structure of code, configs, logs, and prose—ensuring agents receive complete, unbroken methods and sections.

---

### ✨ What’s New in 2.0.0

#### 1. Language-Aware Semantic Chunking (15+ Languages)
Context Mode now includes dedicated syntax parsers that respect logical block boundaries:
* **JavaScript & TypeScript (JSX / TSX)**: Keeps full class bodies, methods, async functions, arrow functions, and JSDoc comment blocks together.
* **Python**: Tracks indentation levels, class definitions, method stacks, and docstrings without separating decorators from their functions.
* **Systems & OOP (Java, C#, C, C++, Go, Rust, PHP, Swift, Kotlin, Scala)**: Tracks brace depth, namespaces, annotations, and struct/implementation blocks.
* **Shell & PowerShell**: Preserves function declarations, parameter blocks, and pipeline filters.
* **SQL**: Intelligently chunks at statement boundaries (`CREATE TABLE`, `SELECT`, stored procedures).

#### 2. Hierarchical Markdown & Document Sectioning
* Chunks Markdown by heading level (`# H1` down to `###### H6`).
* Prepends breadcrumb navigation context (e.g. `# Architecture > ## Storage Engine > ### SQLite Schema`).
* Never splits fenced code blocks, tables, or itemized lists across chunks.

#### 3. Structured Configurations & Markup
* **JSON & JSONC**: Chunks on top-level keys or array slices, preserving valid JSON objects.
* **YAML**: Splits along document dividers (`---`) and root-level keys.
* **TOML & INI**: Keeps section headers (`[database]`) and key-value groups intact.
* **HTML/XML & CSS/SCSS**: Preserves structural tags and stylesheet rules.

#### 4. Stack Trace & Error Log Grouping
* In log files, multi-line error traces (such as Java, Python, or Node.js `at ...`, `Caused by:`) are guaranteed to remain grouped with their originating timestamp and error header in a single chunk.

#### 5. Context-Rich Search Results (`ctx_search`)
* **Complete Method Delivery**: When a matched function or section fits within the 2,048-byte snippet budget, `ctx_search` returns the **entire method intact**—no truncated snippets or missing lines.
* **Line Range Metadata**: Every search result now includes explicit `startLine`, `endLine`, and `context` scope breadcrumbs (e.g., `Lines 42–65 | class FlightComputer > calculateDeltaV()`), giving agents instant orientation.

#### 6. SQLite Schema v4
* Virtual tables `chunks` (BM25) and `chunks_tri` (Trigram) now feature unindexed metadata columns for zero-overhead structural tracking, with automatic database migration from previous versions.

---

### 📊 Release Summary Matrix

| Feature / Capability | v1.4.0 | v1.5.0 | v2.0.0 |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Tool Read Cutoff & Hook Interception** | ✅ Dynamic line scaling | ✅ Auto-index on hook | ✅ Auto-index on hook |
| **File Exemption Controls** | ✅ 1-click category pills | ✅ Injected into agent context | ✅ Injected into agent context |
| **Indexing Model** | Manual (`ctx_index`) | ✅ Just-In-Time (`ctx_search`) | ✅ Just-In-Time (`ctx_search`) |
| **MCP Tool Surface** | 8 tools (with `ctx_index`) | ✅ 7 streamlined tools | ✅ 7 streamlined tools |
| **Log Search Strategy** | Standard | ✅ Reverse / Tail-First | ✅ Tail-First + Stack Trace Grouping |
| **Chunking Engine** | Byte & line buckets | Byte & line buckets | ✅ **AST & Syntax-Aware Semantic Engine** |
| **Code Structure Preservation** | Partial | Partial | ✅ **15+ Languages, Classes & Methods Intact** |
| **Markdown Chunking** | Line-based | Line-based | ✅ **Heading Breadcrumbs (`# H1 > ## H2`)** |
| **Search Result Snippets** | Centered window slice | Centered window slice | ✅ **Complete Intact Method (up to 2 KB)** |
| **Search Metadata** | Score & source | Path & score | ✅ **Lines X–Y, Enclosing Scope Context** |
| **SQLite Schema** | Schema v2 | Schema v3 (`path` PK) | ✅ **Schema v4 (Unindexed Scope Metadata)** |
